title: Lineage of the Prophet ﷺ
intro: Al-Mubarakfuri divides the lineage of the Prophet into three parts. The first part — from Muhammad to Adnan — is agreed upon by all genealogists. The second part, from Adnan to Ishmael, has scholarly differences. The third part, from Abraham to Adam, derives from Judeo-Christian traditions and is unconfirmed by scholars.

disepakati.title: Agreed Lineage
disepakati.desc: The first part is universally agreed upon by consensus (ijma') among scholars, historians, and genealogists without dispute. The order of 21 generations from Prophet Muhammad ﷺ to Adnan is authentically recorded.

items.note: Messenger of Allah, son of Abdullah. Born in Makkah in the Year of the Elephant (571 CE).
His noble father. Passed away in Yatsrib before Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born.
Original name Syaibah. The grandfather who raised him and a prominent leader of Quraysh.
Original name Amr. From his name arose the Hashimite family designation.
Original name al-Mughirah. A highly revered leader of Quraysh.
Original name Zaid. Unifier of the Quraysh tribes and custodian of the Kaaba.
Lineage junction with the maternal line of the Prophet, Aminah bint Wahb.
Noble ancestor titled Quraysh — the title that became the name of the tribe.
Original name Qais.
Original name Amir.
The terminus of consensus agreed upon by all scholars and historians. All scholars agree Adnan is a descendant of Prophet Ishmael (p.b.u.h.).

diperselisihkan.title: Disputed Lineage
diperselisihkan.desc: The second part contains scholarly variations regarding the number of generations and spelling of names (ranging from 7, 9, 15 to 40 names). However, all scholars agree that Adnan is a direct descendant of Prophet Ishmael (p.b.u.h.).

items.note: Ancestor of the Arabized Arabs (Arab Musta'ribah). All scholars agree Adnan is a descendant of Prophet Ishmael (p.b.u.h.).
Son of Prophet Ishmael (p.b.u.h.). His descendants expanded across the Arabian Peninsula.
Son of Prophet Abraham (p.b.u.h.), builder of the Kaaba with his father & forefather of Arab Musta'ribah.

tanpaRujukan.title: Lineage Without Definitive Reference
tanpaRujukan.meta: Gen. 58 → 78 (Prophet Ishmael p.b.u.h. → Prophet Adam p.b.u.h.)
tanpaRujukan.desc: The third part primarily derives from Judeo-Christian traditions (Isra'iliyyat). There are no authentic Quranic or Hadith texts confirming it, so Sheikh al-Mubarakfuri and most scholars refrain from stating it as established fact.

items.note: Son of Prophet Abraham (p.b.u.h.) from Lady Hagar.
Khalilullah (Friend of Allah), father of the Prophets.
Father of Prophet Abraham (p.b.u.h.).
In ancient tradition connected as the origin of the name Hebrew.
Son of Prophet Noah (p.b.u.h.). Primary ancestor of Semitic peoples.
The first Messenger bringing divine law after idolatry appeared on earth.
Identified in Islamic tradition as Prophet Idris (p.b.u.h.).
Son of Prophet Adam (p.b.u.h.) granted prophethood.
The first human being & Father of all humanity created by Allah SWT.

note: Several names in the lineage have dual designations: Abdul Muttalib was originally named Syaibah, Hashim was Amr, Abdu Manaf was al-Mughirah, Qushay was Zaid, Nadhar was Qais, and Mudrikah was Amir. Fihr was the ancestor titled Quraysh — from whom the tribe derived its name.
source: Ar-Rahiq al-Makhtum, Chapter I Part IV, pp. 56–57
